thread:
sasha_perf: Morning — nightly e2e perf job failed the gate for `e2e-chat-stream-1`. 95p latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~185ms (1.54x), gate threshold is 1.3x. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf/nightly/e2e-chat-stream

Config: model=rwd-1.2, batch=8, seq=512, seed=42.
Log snippet:
```
[2026-02-25T01:03:12Z] sample latency (ms): p50=34.2 p90=98.6 p95=185.3 p99=302.1
[2026-02-25T01:03:12Z] throughput tok/s: 720
```

Can someone triage? @chris_sre can you kick a rerun and maybe a bisect if needed. @jamie_eng can you check recent runtime/kernel changes? :thinking:
additional_context:
alex_m: Did we deploy infra changes last night? I noticed kernel-optimizer v2 rolled to dedicated nodes ~01:10 UTC.

priya_r: Which seed/test matrix was used? If it's seed=42 and deterministic, reruns should be comparable. Note: PR #987 (quantize-v2) merged two days ago and touched attention kernels.

jamie_eng: I can bisect across commits (range: commit `abc1234` -> `fedcba9`). Need CI job id to link runs.

sasha_perf: CI job id: `ci/e2e/nightly/2026-02-25/3487`. Full failing metrics above.

chris_sre: @ci-bot please rerun job `ci/e2e/nightly/2026-02-25/3487` with the same matrix. I'll also provision a node pool with kernel-optimizer=1 to compare results.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by @chris_sre: `ci/e2e/nightly/2026-02-25/3487` -> new run `ci/e2e/nightly/2026-02-25/3490`. Status: queued.

(ci-bot later): Run `3490` completed. Results: PASS (functional), perf metrics: p95=140.7ms (1.17x baseline). Gate evaluation: PASS (below 1.3x) but variance is higher than historical. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf/run/3490

jamie_eng: Rerun passed but pretty noisy. That suggests flake or resource interference, not a deterministic regression from code change — yet. I'll start the commit bisect but will also compare runs pinned to kernel-optimizer=v1 vs v2.

alex_m: Confirmed kernel-optimizer v2 was deployed to a subset of dedicated nodes; could cause a skewed sample if test routed to that pool.

priya_r: For E2E gates we should be conservative. Options: 1) increase sample size for nightly, 2) add a canary run pinned to kernel-optimizer v1, 3) create a temporary ticket to revert quantize-v2 from serving if bisect points there.

jamie_eng: I'll open a bisect task and start parallel runs. Command I'm running: `./ci/tools/bisect_perf --job 3487 --from abc1234 --to fedcba9 --matrix "batch=8,seq=512,seed=42"`. Posting progress in this thread.

ci-bot: Bisect started (jobs queued: 12). Updates will appear here.

(30m later) ci-bot: Bisect summary: earliest bad commit narrowed to range `d4f5e6a`..`e7a8b9c`. Change set includes kernel-optimizer v2 and the attention microkernel tweaks from PR #987.

chris_sre: On nodes forced to kernel-optimizer=1 the nightly run p95=122ms (close to baseline). On v2 nodes p95=178ms. That matches the original failure. Reproducible on isolated worker.

sasha_perf: Good find. Next steps: revert or roll back kernel-optimizer v2 on dedicated, or pin e2e jobs to v1 for nightly until we fix. Also open a GH issue for root cause and link perf artifacts.

jamie_eng: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwi/issues/1423 "kernel-optimizer v2 causes p95 regression for e2e-chat-stream" — assigned to @jamie_eng and @chris_sre. Added tags: regression, perf, high-priority.

priya_r: I'll update the gate policy to add a noise filter and increase sampling for next 3 runs. Also scheduling a canary that pins kernel-optimizer=1 for 24h.

alex_m: I'll coordinate the rollback on dedicated nodes if PM approves.

sasha_perf: Thanks everyone. Action items: jamie+chris: RCA + fix PR. priya: adjust gate sampling & canary. alex: standby for rollback. Leaving this thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
